prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production sprite atlas for a pixel-art business game: exactly 3 columns and 5 rows, 15 separate icons, row-major order. Pure black #000 background, no text, no borders, no grid lines. Equal cells, wide black gutters, center each icon with generous inset. Crisp chunky 16-bit pixel art, visible square pixels, dark outlines, limited color ramps, slight three-quarter view, colorful equipment. For intangible rights/licences use a violet document or software disc with a distinctive pictogram of its industry (not a physical machine). Each cell contains exactly the subject listed. Row order:
1: Irrigation system | Greenhouse equipment | Crop-management software licence
2: Refrigerated display counter | Ice-making machine | Cold-chain tracking software licence
3: Coffee roasting machine | Commercial espresso machine | Exclusive coffee-blend licence
4: Vehicle lift | Diagnostic equipment | Vehicle-diagnostics software licence
5: Hydraulic metal press | Industrial welding equipment | Metalworking design licence
revisionPrompt: Preserve the 15 objects and replace all background and colored glows with solid black #000000.
